text:
**Action: edit.** Vout DC sits at 1.655 V and gain is only 11 dB. The likely cause is a broken cascode bias. Because vbn equals the gm/Id = 5 diode Vgs, M1 is left with about 80 mV of Vds (the clamp floor). M1 drops into triode, cannot sink the PMOS mirror current, and the output rails.

The fix is to derive the cascode gate from the bias diode, solved by bisection so that vbn = Vgs3 + 0.3 V. M1 is then sized at that saturated Vds. The PMOS load gets a longer L for gain, and the trim range is widened so refinement can centre vout.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Cascode bias left M1 with ~80 mV Vds (triode), so the NMOS side can't sink the PMOS current and vout rails at 1.655 V. Bias diode is now solved so vbn = Vgs3+0.3 V, M1 sized saturated, PMOS L longer for gain, trim range widened for refinement."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (16e-6, 8e-6, 22e-6),   # main branch current
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # gain device L
    "Lp":     (2.0, 0.8, 3.5),        # PMOS load L (rout -> gain)
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS load / diode gm/Id
    "r4":     (0.35, 0.2, 0.6),       # PMOS-diode branch current ratio I4/I
    "Lb":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # bias diode L
    "gmid3":  (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),      # cascode device gm/Id
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "vds1t":  (0.3, 0.2, 0.45),       # target Vds of M1 (keeps it saturated)
    "trim":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),        # trim of W1 to centre vout DC
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["I"]; I4 = p["r4"] * I
    vout_t = 0.9
    vds1 = p["vds1t"]

    # cascode device first (sets required gate voltage)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=vout_t - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    vbn_t = m3.vgs + vds1

    # bias diode: bisection on gm/Id so Vgs = vbn_t
    lo, hi = 1.5, 25.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, p["Lb"], iref, vds=vbn_t)
        if t.vgs > vbn_t:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    gmid_b = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], iref, vds=vbn_t)
    vbn = mb0.vgs

    # PMOS diode branch
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=1.0)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=m4.vgs)
    vsg4 = m4.vgs
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], I4, vds=vbn)
    I4a = lut.op("n", mb1.W, p["Lb"], vbn, vdd - vsg4)["Id"]

    # PMOS load (mirror of M4)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=vdd - vout_t)
    i4_ref = lut.op("p", m4.W, p["Lp"], vsg4, vsg4)["Id"]
    i2_ref = lut.op("p", m2.W, p["Lp"], vsg4, vdd - vout_t)["Id"]
    I2a = I4a * i2_ref / max(i4_ref, 1e-12)

    # re-size cascode at actual current, recompute M1 Vds
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I2a, vds=vout_t - vds1, vsb=vds1)
        vds1 = max(vbn - m3.vgs, 0.1)

    # gain device M1: width so Id(Vgs=vin) = I2a
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    W1 = max(0.42, I2a / max(o1["Id"], 1e-15) * p["trim"])
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mb1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])

    # predictions
    gout_n = gds1 * m3.gds / (m3.gm + m3.gmbs + m3.gds)
    rout = 1.0 / (m2.gds + gout_n)
    A = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + m2.cdd + m3.cdd + m2.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vlow = vds1 + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = vdd - m2.vdsat - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + I4a + I2a)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": vhigh - vlow}
```
